tacticalSkills.name: Blink
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Teleport a short distance toward a targeted direction. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Temporarily increases Movement Speed, avoiding collisions.

tacticalSkills.name: Quake
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Deal skill damage to enemies nearby and slow them. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Deals damage to nearby enemies for a period of time.

tacticalSkills.name: Protocol Violation
tacticalSkills.tooltip: The modified E.M.O.T.E explodes. Allies receive an HP buff, while enemies take true damage. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement.</color> Effects are stronger.

tacticalSkills.name: Electric Shift
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Quickly move a short distance. Basic Attack Range is increased for a certain amount of time. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> The effect range is increased.

tacticalSkills.name: Force Field
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Activate to create a large force field around you that absorbs explosive damage. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Gain Tenacity for a certain period of time.

tacticalSkills.name: Totem
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Enter Stasis for a short moment. No one can stop you! <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Your skill cooldown rapidly decreases while in Stasis.

tacticalSkills.name: Nullification
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Activate to instantly cleanse debuffs or Crowd Control effects on you and your nearby allies, and increase movement speed. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Use it to increase your and your allies' Tenacity.

tacticalSkills.name: Soul Stealer
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Gain energy based on HP lost during combat with nearby enemy characters. Upon use, all energy is consumed, and nearby allies receive Movement Speed and Omnisyphon buffs. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Obtain even more energy.

tacticalSkills.name: The Strijder
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Increases your movement speed toward the enemy, and if you damage them during the duration, you deal additional skill damage and your movement speed increases for a moment. <color=#FF3399>Upon Enhancement:</color>Enemies damaged by The Strijder are slowed.

tacticalSkills.name: Blade of Truth
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Deals damage to nearby enemies and increases Movement Speed based on how many targets were hit. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Another blade of truth is summoned, dealing additional damage.

tacticalSkills.name: False Oath
tacticalSkills.tooltip: All damage increases at the expense of your HP. Used HP is slowly recovered. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> If you assist killing an enemy character, the effect is renewed.

tacticalSkills.name: Healing Wind
tacticalSkills.tooltip: All allies within range recover HP. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Allies touched by the wind recover additional HP for a certain amount of time.

tacticalSkills.name: Repulsor Missiles
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Move a short distance and fire a missile towards the nearest enemy character within range, dealing true damage to enemies hit. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Additional missiles are fired.

tacticalSkills.name: Plasma Dash
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Move a short distance and fire Plasma energy forward, dealing skill damage and slowing enemies hit. Damage is only applied once even if hit by multiple projectiles. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Reduces the defense of enemies hit by the projectile.

tacticalSkills.name: Wings of Light
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Slow effects applied to you are removed. Movement speed and attack speed are increased for a certain amount of time. <color=#ff3399>Upon enhancement:</color> Hitting enemy characters with basic attacks increases the duration.

tacticalSkills.name: Gravitational Field
tacticalSkills.tooltip: After a moment, it pulls in nearby enemies, stunning them.

tacticalSkills.name: Rolling Thunder
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Dramatically increases your movement speed for a certain period of time.

tacticalSkills.name: Truth Explosion
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Bursts out energy, striking nearby enemy test subjects after a short time, gaining a bonus on successful hits. Failed hits are penalized.

tacticalSkills.name: Impulse
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Stop for a short time then dash toward the targeted direction.

tacticalSkills.name: Prayer
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Allies within a certain range are shielded.

tacticalSkills.name: Fissure
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Create a Fissure in the ground in an area in front of you, dealing damage. Enemies affected are stunned and slowed.

tacticalSkills.name: Fantastical Punch
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Summon the illusory fist of a genie in the targeted direction Test subjects hit fly in that direction.

tacticalSkills.name: Meteor
tacticalSkills.tooltip: A meteorite will soon spawn in the targeted location, dealing true damage. Enemies hit by meteorites are stunned for a short time.

tacticalSkills.name: Lightning Shield
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Apply Lightining Shield to the specified ally, eliminating all debuffs and crowd control effects. The Dragon's Blessing deals damage to surrounding enemies.

tacticalSkills.name: Blessing: Calm Mind
tacticalSkills.tooltip: Immediately recovers a portion of your Max HP, followed by additional recovery for a short period of time.
